integrity.verification: standalone deterministic checker verifies sample instances and cannot replace the universal analytic proof

scientific_limitations: Continuous-time two-class homogeneous seasonal occupancy model; no yearly probability caps or upper bounds on colonization rates.
Fixed positive extinction rates, arbitrarily adjustable positive colonization intensities, and linear rate-unit costs; no realistic fitted intervention production function.
Mathematical equilibrium targets only; no stochastic extinction-time, empirical policy, or spatially resolved guarantee.

Prior literature comparison supports an explicit three-phase allocation contribution but is not an exhaustive independent historical-priority certification; alternative SIS/geometric-program formulations are a residual risk.
title: Sharp three-regime minimum-cost law for migratory seasonal occupancy
